race.comment: VANDAROSS (8) returns after a 21-week spell. Closed last prep with three appearances in stakes races, the highlight a third to the smart Verzain in the Group 3 Breeders. Recent jump-out winner who looks poised to break through then go on to better things this campaign. BILK (4) made it four minor placings from six starts when he found one better as $3.10 favourite over 1250m at Morphettville Parks recently. Gets in well again after the claim and cannot be written off. YOURWORSTNIGHTMARE (9) left his run too late and was runner-up on debut over 1100m at Gawler ten days ago. Has been gelded since that run. Looks a key runner. VETTURA (13) run on powerfully over 1100m on debut here last time. One to watch for in the dying stages.
